# snipeit_fieldset (Data Source)

Looks up a fieldset by `id` or `name`, including the custom fields it contains.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "snipeit_fieldset" "laptop" {
  name = "Laptop Details"
}

output "laptop_field_names" {
  value = [for f in data.snipeit_fieldset.laptop.fields : f.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the fieldset.
- `name` (String) Name of the fieldset.

### Read-Only

- `fields` (Attributes List) Custom fields contained in the fieldset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields))

<a id="nestedatt--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields`

Read-Only:

- `db_column_name` (String) Database column name.
- `element` (String) Form element type.
- `format` (String) Validation format.
- `id` (Number) Field id.
- `name` (String) Field name.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether the field is required in this fieldset.
